name: signlytic-desktop
description: Signlytic AI desktop app - BSL signing avatar for Windows and macOS
author: Independent Robotics & AI Systems Engineer

scripts.dist: npm run sync-vendor && node scripts/build-mac-helper.js && electron-builder

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Signlytic AI listens to the microphone so speech in the room can be captioned and signed in British Sign Language.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Signlytic AI turns speech into text on this Mac so it can be translated into British Sign Language.
